scenes.headline: How Microsoft pre-trained a 2.8T model in 38 days
scenes.sub: A dropless mixture of experts, Muon at scale, and arithmetic that closes.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Pumice! Microsoft AI just finished pre-training MAI Base Two. Here is how it works, and whether its numbers add up.

scenes.label: What's new
scenes.text: Expert imbalance now costs a little time instead of memory or dropped tokens, so every layer can be a mixture of experts.
scenes.say: The trick is making expert imbalance cheap: it costs a little time, never memory or dropped tokens.

scenes.title: One MoE layer, without dropping tokens

steps.say: Each token is routed to seven of five hundred and twelve experts, plus one shared expert.
Experts sit in groups, each with a fixed number of token slots, so memory never changes.
A hot expert borrows empty slots from its neighbours. What still overflows runs in another round.
Nothing is dropped and nothing crashes. A load balancing loss still nudges the router.
In round zero every group has tokens, and communication overlaps the compute.
In round one only two groups overflow. The round count is global, so the third waits.

scenes.title: Muon across 16k GPUs
scenes.say: Muon needs whole matrices, but the momentum is sharded.

items.say: Each GPU updates its own slice of the momentum.
One exchange hands every GPU a set of complete matrices.
A second exchange sends the updates home. It all costs about two percent of a step.

parts.say: Training cost is about six times active parameters, eighty billion,

parts.note: what the cluster has to deliver
parts.say: That is the work the cluster has to deliver.

scenes.title: Needed against delivered
scenes.say: Sixteen thousand GPUs, thirty-eight days, twenty-one percent utilisation, eighty-nine percent goodput. The sides agree within about five percent.

scenes.label: fewer FLOPs than DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Base for the same bits per byte
scenes.note: on Microsoft's own held-out sets, largest on its own code
scenes.say: Microsoft reports matching DeepSeek's base model with four to twelve times fewer FLOPs, measured on its own test sets.

scenes.text: Imbalance became a scheduling cost, not an outage. That is what let every layer be a mixture of experts.
scenes.say: Imbalance became a scheduling cost, not an outage.

recap: Dropless MoE: fixed memory, extra rounds
scenes.say: To recap: fixed memory with extra rounds, Muon by resharding, and numbers that close.
